properties.name: RC_cyclopentadiene
properties.note: Cyclopentadiene minimum on the reactant side of the [1,5] IRC: unconstrained opt+freq started from the canonical IRC outer frame end-b, 0 imaginary frequencies (lowest real 339.15 cm-1), H6 on C3 (C3-H6 1.107 A, C4-H6 2.177 A), E = -193.978501467 Ha. An independently built conformer of the same minimum (cpH/reactant_optfreq.log, E = -193.978501557 Ha, 0 imaginary) is 0.00000009 Ha lower and is the barrier reference energy; both give dE(double dagger) = 26.58 kcal/mol.

properties.name: TS1_H_shift
properties.note: Cs-symmetric [1,5]-H shift saddle: opt=(TS,CalcFC,NoEigentest)+freq, exactly 1 imaginary frequency -1195.42 cm-1 (90.8% of the unweighted squared displacement on the migrating H6, symmetric C3-H6/C4-H6 projections 0.647/0.645); C3-H6 = C4-H6 = 1.316 A, H6 1.06 A above the ring plane, ring bonds 1.404/1.412/1.490/1.412/1.404 A. IRC proof in cpH/irc_both_v2.log. The node's declared SMILES is the cyclopentadiene connectivity of the saddle (H bridging C3/C4), the same annotation written in the TS input title.

properties.name: P_cyclopentadiene
properties.note: Degenerate product cyclopentadiene with H6 migrated to C4 (C4-H6 1.107 A, C3-H6 2.177 A), pi pattern C2=C3 / C5=C1; unconstrained opt+freq started from the canonical IRC outer frame end-a, 0 imaginary frequencies (lowest real 339.15 cm-1), E = -193.978501467 Ha, degenerate with the reactant minimum within 9e-8 Ha.
